values: 30001179 / OWR-3392-005: Generation of Free Product Systems by Tensor Subsystems

A continuous free product system not generated by its tensor core — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0 (2026-10-21). Unrefereed preprint. An analytic continuous pointed free product system E of separable complex Hilbert spaces has maximal tensor core F equal to decreasing finite-word Fock space; its closed free hull is K, all finite words, and K is proper in E at every t>0 via a nonzero ordinal grade-omega sector. Associativity, an explicit continuous field including time zero, positive-time local triviality, and continuity of structure maps and inverses are proved. The stated field convention is part of the theorem; arbitrary stronger regularity is not asserted. This answers the universal generation clause negatively in the scalar specialization; the shared generation clause of OWR-3392-004 / 30001178 is the same target, while its cocycle clauses and OWR-3392-006 / 30001180 forward recovery remain distinct. No general cocycle, recovery or classification theorem claimed. Classical Fock, Gaussian and Radon-Nikodym inputs are credited. Bounded actual primary-source comparison found no authenticated earlier exact negative construction; the named in-preparation manuscript and unpublished/unrecorded talk bodies remain unrecovered. No worldwide novelty, historical firstness or still-open-in-2026 claim. PDF and editable-source/verification ZIP preserve all eleven originals and scoped historical audits. Finite replay supplements the analytic infinite-dimensional proof and does not certify it. Extensive AI involvement in research planning, proof development and reconstruction, computation, literature investigation, writing and adversarial verification. No formal independent human peer review or proof-assistant certification; internal AI audits are not human peer review.
